cases.normativeDifference: CSS Animations 2 section 3.2 groups declarations by the computed composition, defaulting to the element composition. Omitted and explicit replace therefore form one offset group here; Chromium instead distinguishes its API auto token, retaining two frames and sampling .1 instead of .3 at 250ms. Raw results are stable after rendering.

cases.normativeDifference: CSS Animations 2 section 3.2 keeps metadata-only frames, inserts missing property endpoints with default timing, and prepends the synthetic initial frame. Web Animations 1 section 5.3.4 removes frames without the sampled property. Chromium reports separate linear synthetic frames but samples the metadata-only steps frame for other properties; stable after rendering. Replaying the exported frames as a WAAPI effect confirms the per-property standard result; raw paint and replay are both preserved.
